title: Attribute tags
text: A prop that holds markup is written as markup, inside the call. Pipes make it a function of its parameters.

title: Name sugar
text: `#id`, `.class` and `:name` sit on the tag, where a selector would put them.

title: Control flow
text: Conditions and loops are tags with a body: no ternaries, no `.map()`.

title: Attributes
text: A value is any expression, with no braces around it: an atom, a comparison, an object, a spread.

title: Text
text: `${}` escapes what it prints. `$!{}` inserts markup, and you have to ask for it.

title: Values
text: `static` runs once per module, `<const>` on every render, and `<let>` is state.

title: Tags you define
text: `<define>` names a fragment you call like a tag. A file in `tags/` needs no import and can hand a value back.

title: A typed module
text: Imports are TypeScript's. The exported `Input` is the type every caller is checked against.

title: Concise mode, comments
text: Drop the angle brackets and indent instead. An HTML comment stays in the source.
